newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes lower, volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes lower, volume rises.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange closed slightly lower on Monday but volume rose, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 601.32, down from 603.12 on Friday.
Traded volume was 2.29 million dinars against 1.36 million dinars. Exchanges of 20,706 shares over the counter amounted to 2.51 million dinars.
Banque de Tunisie fell 2.31 dinars to 76.69. BIAT bank was up 0.76 dinar at 61.92.
